note: The watchlist (CW 2). max_stocks caps the list; lookback_days is the 52-week window and min_history_days the history a stock needs before its 52-week range is judged; basis_tolerance (a fraction) is how far yesterday's close in a live packet may differ from the cached close before alerts for the stock stop for the day (a split or bonus); alert_batch_s is the seconds one digest email waits to collect alerts; max_alert_emails_per_day caps the digests; results_lead_trading_days is how many trading days ahead a results meeting is announced; tap_frames is the length of the recorder tap's frame queue.
